steps: Read the latest fixed master handoff and fetch the branch; prefer the verified science commit if available.
If Git science is unavailable, check out base_commit exactly and extract the 36-path archive at repository root.
Verify every path against the external manifest and require git write-tree to equal science_tree; never apply over a newer tree.
Run check_grounded_anchor.py and require 256/16/240, 64 unique-anchor non-isomorphisms, restricted 4 anchor-free isomorphisms, 8 anchored non-isomorphisms and 8 coordinate flips.
Run audit_map.py against the effective restored map and require 913/424/261, zero unresolved references, zero cycles and zero bad all_of.
Manually recheck actual-token, complete-signature, H_tip/report, ownership/agency and no-unique-owner boundaries.
